summary: Set up a static site generator project using Eleventy (11ty). Created project structure with src/ directory containing a Nunjucks base layout template (with HTML5 boilerplate, nav, content block, footer), CSS stylesheet (reset, typography, 2-3 column grid layouts), and JS module. Configured Eleventy to output to build/ with asset passthrough copy. Build runs successfully and produces valid HTML with correctly linked CSS and JS assets.
